method: Manual call/state traces plus selected independent arithmetic; no reference algorithms executed

WP39_generation.wild_start_species_level: one construction before override/skip; core receives Pokemon references
WP39_generation.core_direct_species_level: skip precedes construction; on_start then construction if not skipped
WP39_generation.callback_identity: same generated object reused by core

WP39_writeback.battler_ability_set: local ability changes, Pokemon ability unchanged

WP40_run: player pbRun evaluated in command phase; return0 continues menu; -1/1 end further player choices; debug cancellation -1 also ends choices

WP40_move.called_non_Struggle_special: initial skipAccuracy flag true; later checks skip after common early gates
WP40_move.multi_turn_continuation: specialUsage becomes true later; initial skipAccuracy flag remains false
WP40_move.Struggle: specialUsage true but skipAccuracy false; e.g. sleep still checked
WP40_move.normal_move_no_targets: PP already deducted if earlier gates passed

WP40_item: ball executor dispatches UseInBattle directly, unlike generic CanUseInBattle recheck/refund branches

WP40_snatch.same_number_tie: first encountered eligible battler; not highest number

WP41_run.duringBattle_true: skips certain escape/trapping checks; does not increment count but uses existing count
WP41_run.speed_source: battler.speed snapshot, which Transform can overwrite; not permanent Pokemon speed

WP41_switch: registration checks do not mean recall/replace repeats CanSwitch; canSwitch global flag is a UI/AI gate; direct domain checks differ
WP41_forms: ordinary switch calls departure hook but no blanket makeUnmega/makeUnprimal; faint and after_battle explicitly restore
WP41_drag: higher-level sole wild: Roar fails, damaging Dragon Tail can deal damage but not end battle; damaging wild-end branch omits Suction Cups/Ingrain checks that gate trainer switching
correct_baselines: three-way obedience integer gate and replacement move PP reread
